title: Cannabis
citation: DEA, Drugs of Abuse: A DEA Resource Guide (2024 ed.), pp. 90-92
key_points: Signs: bloodshot eyes, raised pulse, increased appetite, sedation, impaired coordination, poor memory and problem-solving, distorted time perception; anxiety or panic in some users.
No overdose deaths are reported, but emergency visits involving edibles are rising.
officer_notes: In NJ, odor alone does not justify a search for possession (see 2C:35-10); impaired driving is still a 39:4-50 offense.
